svg.title: Locksmith — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as locksmith, wearing a work jacket. Visible work cue: A profiled lock cylinder with keyway is paired with a separate service key and a fine bent lock pick below. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: curly hair, an oval face.
